```{r}
#| label: load_libraries_rs
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| error:   false

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(broom.mixed)
library(performance)
library(glue)
```

```{r}
#| label: load_fire_data
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| error:   false

load("cfmg.RData")

# CFMG areas from GIS shapefile (hectares → km²) and governance index
normalise_name <- function(x) {
  x |> str_to_lower() |> str_replace_all("[_()]+", " ") |> str_squish()
}

cfmg_attrs <- cfmg |>
  filter(interview_type == "cfmg_executive") |>
  group_by(cfmg_name) |>
  summarise(
    area_km2  = mean(`Size (Hectares)`, na.rm = TRUE) / 100,
    gov_index = mean(gov_index,         na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(join_key = normalise_name(as.character(cfmg_name)))

fire_raw <- read_csv("../data/fire_with_zones.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    acq_date  = dmy(acq_date),
    date_est  = ymd(DATEEST),
    month     = month(acq_date),
    NAME      = str_to_sentence(NAME),
    # fix known spelling variant
    NAME      = if_else(NAME == "Kaluzya", "Kalunzyu", NAME),
    join_key  = normalise_name(NAME),
    period    = factor(
      if_else(acq_date < date_est, "Before", "After"),
      levels = c("Before", "After")
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(cfmg_attrs |> select(join_key, area_km2, gov_index), by = "join_key")
```

## Introduction

*To do*

```{r}
#| label: data_fire
#| include: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| error:   false

fire_annual <- fire_raw |>
  mutate(det_area = scan * track) |>
  group_by(NAME, PROVINCE, Year, period, area_km2, gov_index) |>
  summarise(
    fire_count  = n(),
    burned_area = sum(det_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_frp   = sum(frp,      na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(area_km2), !is.na(gov_index)) |>
  mutate(
    fire_density  = fire_count  / area_km2,
    burn_fraction = burned_area / area_km2,
    frp_density   = total_frp   / area_km2,
    log_density   = log1p(fire_density),
    log_burn      = log1p(burn_fraction),    # kept for reference; model uses raw burn_fraction
    log_frp_dens  = log1p(frp_density)
  )

M_count <- lmer(log_density  ~ period + gov_index + (1 | NAME), data = fire_annual, REML = TRUE)
M_area  <- glmer(burn_fraction ~ period + gov_index + (1 | NAME),
                 family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = fire_annual)
M_frp   <- lmer(log_frp_dens ~ period + gov_index + (1 | NAME), data = fire_annual, REML = TRUE)
```

## Fire incidence

```{r}
#| label: fig-fire_count
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| error:   false
#| fig-cap: "Annual fire detection density (detections per km²) per CFMG before and after establishment. Each point represents one CFMG-year. Boxes show median and interquartile range; y-axis is on a log scale."
#| fig-height: 4

fire_annual |>
  ggplot(aes(x = period, y = fire_density, fill = period)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_y_log10(name = expression("Fire detections per km"^2*" per year (log scale)")) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Before" = "#E9C46A", "After" = "#2A9D8F")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "none",
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-fire_count_model
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| error:   false
#| tbl-cap: "Linear mixed model results for log-transformed annual fire count before and after CF establishment."

re_count    <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(M_count))
cfmg_count  <- round(re_count$vcov[re_count$grp == "NAME"],     3)
resid_count <- round(re_count$vcov[re_count$grp == "Residual"], 3)
r2_count    <- suppressWarnings(performance::r2_nakagawa(M_count))

tidy(M_count, effects = "fixed") |>
  mutate(term = case_match(term,
    "(Intercept)"  ~ "Intercept (Before)",
    "periodAfter"  ~ "After",
    "gov_index"    ~ "Governance index"
  )) |>
  select(term, estimate, std.error, p.value) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(term = "Factor", estimate = "Estimate", std.error = "SE",
             p.value = md("*P* value")) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(estimate, std.error), decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_number(columns = p.value, decimals = 4) |>
  tab_header(
    title    = "Model results for fire detection density (log-transformed) — before vs after establishment",
    subtitle = glue(
      "Linear mixed model with random intercept for CFMG. ",
      "Response = log(detections per km² + 1). Fixed effects: period (ref = Before) and governance index. ",
      "CFMG variance = {cfmg_count}; residual variance = {resid_count}. ",
      "Marginal R² = {round(r2_count$R2_marginal, 3)}; ",
      "conditional R² = {round(r2_count$R2_conditional, 3)}. ",
      "n = {nobs(M_count)}."
    )
  ) |>
  opt_align_table_header(align = "left") |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -term) |>
  cols_align(align = "left",   columns = term) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "center"),
            locations = cells_column_labels(columns = term)) |>
  sub_missing()
```


## Fire radiative power

```{r}
#| label: fig-frp
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| error:   false

fire_annual |>
  ggplot(aes(x = period, y = frp_density, fill = period)) +

    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),

  )
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-frp_model

re_frp    <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(M_frp))

tidy(M_frp, effects = "fixed") |>

  select(term, estimate, std.error, p.value) |>

    title    = "Model results for total FRP per km² (log-transformed) — before vs after establishment",

      "Response = log(total FRP / CFMG area + 1). Fixed effects: period (ref = Before) and governance index. ",
      "CFMG variance = {cfmg_frp}; residual variance = {resid_frp}. ",
```
